name: Studio Headphones
description: Closed-back over-ear headphones with soft memory-foam cushions and a flat, honest sound for long listening sessions.

name: Wireless Earbuds
description: Light earbuds with a pocket-size charging case. Up to 6 hours per charge and 24 hours with the case.

name: Portable Speaker
description: A splash-proof speaker with 360° sound that fills a room and still fits in a backpack.

name: Minimal Watch
description: A clean 38 mm dial, sapphire glass and a vegetable-tanned leather strap that ages beautifully.

name: Canvas Backpack
description: Waxed canvas, a padded 15-inch laptop sleeve and a front pocket for the things you reach for most.

name: Classic Sunglasses
description: Acetate frames with polarised, UV400 lenses. Comes with a hard case and a cleaning cloth.

name: Insulated Bottle
description: 750 ml stainless steel. Keeps drinks cold for 24 hours or hot for 12, and never sweats.

name: Running Sneakers
description: A breathable knit upper on a responsive foam sole, made for daily runs and long walks.

name: Ceramic Mug
description: A hand-glazed 350 ml stoneware mug. Dishwasher and microwave safe.

name: Desk Lamp
description: An adjustable arm with a warm, dimmable LED. Bright enough for work, soft enough for evenings.

name: Monstera Plant
description: An easy-care Monstera in a 14 cm terracotta pot. Likes bright, indirect light and weekly water.

name: Dot Grid Notebook
description: A5, 192 pages of 100 gsm dot-grid paper, lay-flat binding and an elastic closure. Pencil included.
